text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and I take pride in producing accurate, well-organized work that respects both content and format.

With 5 years of experience in data analysis, SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, I can help with tasks that require careful attention to detail and consistency. I understand that when documents are text-heavy, the priority is not just moving information around, but preserving the original structure, style, and layout while making sure key sections are handled accurately.

In my past work, I built a marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare by joining ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit. That work helped reallocate 18% of ad budget and brought customer acquisition cost down 12% the next quarter. I also completed a parent survey analysis for Riverbend Education Fund, where I cleaned and weighted a 4,200-response survey and wrote the findings for the board; 3 findings were adopted in the next funding plan.

I bring the same disciplined approach to every project: careful review, clean structure, and reliable output. If your documents need attention to detail, accuracy in key sections, and faithful formatting, I’m confident I can support you well. I’m comfortable working through text-based material methodically and making sure nothing important is missed.

I’d be glad to discuss your project and understand exactly what sections need the most care so I can deliver work that matches your expectations.
